left.title: Republicans Sink Trump Judicial Nominee Hostile To Black Voters’ Rights
left.body: Sens. Tim Scott and Jeff Flake joined Democrats in rejecting Thomas Farr to be a lifetime federal judge.
left.roundup: Republican Sen. Tim Scott announced he would oppose judicial nominee Thomas Farr amid allegations that he worked to suppress black voters in North Carolina, effectively derailing his confirmation.

center.title: Trump Judicial Nominee Set To Fail Amid Voter Suppression Charges
center.body: The controversial judicial nomination of Thomas Farr has been derailed in the Senate. South Carolina Sen. Tim Scott — the lone African-American Republican in the Senate — sealed Farr's fate
center.roundup: Republican Sen. Tim Scott announced he would oppose judicial nominee Thomas Farr amid allegations that he worked to suppress black voters in North Carolina, effectively derailing his confirmation.
